extractions.description: This paper introduces a novel attention mechanism, Compositional Attention, which disentangles search and retrieval in transformer models. By allowing dynamic and flexible combinations of search and retrieval operations, it aims to reduce redundant parameters and improve generalization in transformer models. The mechanism is shown to outperform standard multi-head attention across various tasks, including visual question answering, logical reasoning, and language modeling, among others.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on improving the efficiency and generalization of attention mechanisms in machine learning models, without any explicit link to Climate or Ecologically-Related Sustainable Development goals.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Experiments on various tasks show that our proposed method outperforms standard multi-head transformers, while often using only a fraction of retrievals.
